fact: On 14 August 2026 the Head of the Civil Service inaugurated a steering committee whose terms include a framework for adopting the 1Gov Cloud as the federal government's sovereign work environment with Galaxy Backbone Limited as infrastructure provider, and an audit of MDAs' digital readiness including training and capacity.
title: Federal Government Inaugurates Steering Committee On Digital Transformation Of The Federal Civil Service
publisher: Federal Ministry of Information and National Orientation
